review_summary: The local publishHandSlot extraction appears behavior-equivalent for the scoped publish-section refactor.
Primary left/right publish conditions, output maps, output keys, and stage tags remain equivalent.
Fallback still only considers allowed owners with body evidence and publishes under the same ownerFaceId.
The new occupied-id insertion inside fallback does not appear to change behavior because m_handTracks is keyed uniquely by owner and each owner is visited once per fallback loop.
No API/header surface, lifecycle cleanup, or unrelated logic changes were introduced.
residual_risks: Reviewer only performed static review and did not run build/tests or replay tracking scenarios.
Host build evidence covers compile; runtime replay and unit tests were not executed.
